description: The FULL encyclopaedia card for one concept — body, cheat sheet, glossary, pro tip, and the four analysis tables (decision table, peer comparison, named pitfalls, performance facts), EN, FR and DE, plus why-it-matters and key points (those two are also published free on the concept page; here they come structured, in three languages, in the same payload) — the corpus the €29.90 Consultant Pass sells. On THIS endpoint the machine-access subscription is the MCP Pass (€39.90/month, analyticslegends.ai/pricing/), which opens the ENTIRE paid tranche from one key; the €29.90 Consultant Pass is its web-subscriber equivalent and opens the same tier floor here. Requires a subscriber API key (Authorization: Bearer alk_…), Consultant tier or above; without one this tool refuses and get_concept keeps serving the public metadata. Find slugs with search_concepts.
name: get_concept_card
title: Full concept card (Consultant tier)
